hard_invariants: same legal candidate multiset across all arms
same RNG seed per fixture across paired arms
TRM proposal cannot add, delete, or directly execute a move
mismatched residual must be distinct and same-cardinality or fail closed
future R0.2 final population remains unopened until harness and tests freeze

intervention.acceptance_objective: unchanged deterministic predecessor _cost; TRM score is never part of candidate cost
intervention.authority: TRM proposal is never applied; only externally legal moves may be applied
intervention.guided_order: stable descending sort after shuffle by fraction of cells changed by a legal move that agree with the TRM proposal

scientific_question: Does the frozen TRM-0 structural signal improve bounded legal search when used only as an equal-cost candidate tie-breaker?
secondary_endpoint: steps-to-resolution on fixtures jointly resolved by compared arms
